newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek police confiscate six tonnes of hashish.
newsitem.headline: Greek police confiscate six tonnes of hashish.

text.p: Greek police confiscated six tonnes of hashish inside a container at the main port of Piraeus on Monday and two people were arrested as suspects.
"The container arrived in Greece on a ship from Egypt on May 2. It was originally loaded in Pakistan and the final destination was Bulgaria," a police official told Reuters.
He said nobody had claimed the container and its papers said it contained towels and other fabrics.
Police last month confiscated another abandoned container packed with four tonnes of hashish from Cambodia.
